# Breadcrumb

**Class:** `UltraCanvasBreadcrumb` · **Group:** [Navigation and data views](../Groups/Navigation-and-data-views.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasBreadcrumb.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasBreadcrumb.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasBreadcrumb.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Path bar

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasBreadcrumbExamples](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasBreadcrumbExamples.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasBreadcrumb> CreateBreadcrumb( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w = 400, float h = 28);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasBreadcrumb(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
UltraCanvasBreadcrumb(const std::string& identifier, float w, float h);
explicit UltraCanvasBreadcrumb(const std::string& identifier = "");
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onItemClicked` | `std::function<void(int index, const BreadcrumbItem& item)> onItemClicked` | Fired when a (non-current) item is clicked. index is the item index in the path. |
| `onItemDropdown` | `std::function<void(int index, const BreadcrumbItem& item)> onItemDropdown` | Fired when the dropdown chevron of an item is clicked. |
| `onOverflowOpened` | `std::function<void()> onOverflowOpened` | Fired when the overflow ("...") menu is opened. |
| `onPathChanged` | `std::function<void()> onPathChanged` | Fired when the path changes via SetPath / Add / Remove / Clear. |
| `AddItem()` | `void AddItem(const std::string& text, std::function<void()> onClick)` | Takes a callback. |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Option types in this header

### enum `BreadcrumbSeparatorStyle`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Chevron` | Drawn "&gt;" shape (vector path) |
| `ChevronDouble` | Drawn "&gt;&gt;" shape (vector path) |
| `Slash` | Text "/" |
| `BackSlash` | Text "\\" |
| `GreaterThan` | Text "&gt;" |
| `Arrow` | Text "-&gt;" |
| `Bullet` | Text "*" |
| `Pipe` | Text "\|" |
| `Dot` | Text "." |
| `NoSeparator` | No separator drawn between items |
| `CustomText` | Use customSeparatorText from style |
| `CustomIcon` | Use customSeparatorIcon from style |

### enum `BreadcrumbOverflowMode`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Clip` | No overflow handling, clip whatever doesn't fit |
| `Collapse` | Collapse middle items into a "..." menu |
| `Ellipsize` | Ellipsize individual item texts |
| `ShrinkText` | Reduce per-item maxTextWidth until everything fits |

### enum `BreadcrumbItemStyle`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Plain` | Text only (default), background only on hover/press |
| `Pill` | Each item drawn with rounded background |
| `Underline` | Text with hover underline |
| `Tab` | Tab-like with bottom border |
| `Arrow` | Interlocking right-pointing arrow/chevron segments ("steps") |
| `Parallelogram` | Interlocking slanted (skewed) segments |

### enum `BreadcrumbLevelIndicatorBackground`

Optional leading badge that shows each item's level number (1-based).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NoBackground` | Number only, no background fill (named to avoid X11's `None` macro) |
| `Round` | Number inside a filled circle |
| `Rectangle` | Number inside a filled rounded rectangle |

### struct `FolderBreadcrumbOptions`

Every dropdown below - the drives under "Computer" as much as the sub-folders under a path segment - is filled when it opens, so building the strip can be redone on each navigation without delaying it. All a segment asks the filesystem while it is laid out is whether it holds a first sub-folder at all: a segment with nothing under it shows no dropdown chevron rather than opening an empty menu.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `showComputerItem` | `bool showComputerItem = true` | Leading node listing every drive / mounted volume in its dropdown. |
| `computerLabel` | `std::string computerLabel` | Empty: "Computer" in the language shown. |
| `subFolderDropdowns` | `bool subFolderDropdowns = true` | Per-segment dropdown listing the folders inside that segment, so the path can be extended one level straight from the strip. |
| `onComputerClick` | `std::function<void()> onComputerClick` | What a click on the "Computer" node itself does. Unset, it navigates to the drive root of the shown path; a file manager with a page of its own for the machine (UltraFiler's Computer page) opens that instead. The node's dropdown lists the drives either way. |
| `driveLabel` | `std::function<std::string(const std::string& root)> driveLabel` | What a drive or mounted volume is called on the strip - its own node and its entry in the "Computer" node's list - given its root ("D:\\", "/media/bob/USB STICK"). Unset, or an empty answer, keeps the default: the drive letter on Windows, the root path elsewhere. A file manager that has read the volumes' own names … |
